newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian PM stands by 5 pct jobless view.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian PM stands by 5 pct jobless view.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Thursday he saw no reason to back away from his 1991 statement that unemployment was unlikely to fall below 5.0 percent in his lifetime.
But he repeated that the government had no intention of setting an unemployment rate target.
"I have no reason to doubt for a moment the voracity of what I said then," Howard told parliament.
Howard made the statement on August 8, 1991, when he was opposition industrial relations spokesman.

"Let me repeat what I have said repeatedly since I became prime minister of Australia and that is that I will do all in my power to implement policies to reduce the level of unemployment in this country," Howard said.
"And I am not going to hitch myself to a particular target."
Australia's unemployment rate was at 8.8 percent in February, up from 8.6 percent in the previous month.
